info.name: CricAPI Cricket Data Fantasy Series API

params.name: offset
params.description: Row offset for pagination. Default page size is 25 items. Use totalRows from the info object to determine if more pages exist.

params.name: search
params.description: Search string to filter series by name or short name

items.docs: Returns a descending-order (latest first) list of all cricket series covered. Series may have partial coverage for some matches. Supports pagination and optional search by name.
